terms.zh: 俄羅斯海軍深海研究總局
terms.expansion: Glavnoye Upravleniye Glubokovodnykh Issledovaniy (Main Directorate of Deep-Sea Research)

def.zh: 俄羅斯海軍下轄、直屬國防部的深海特種作戰單位，掌管深海潛艦、水下無人載具與海底基礎設施相關的秘密行動，長期被西方情報機構認為與海底電纜、管線周邊的可疑活動有關；美、英均已對其實施制裁。
def.en: A Russian naval directorate reporting directly to the Ministry of Defence that operates deep-sea submarines and uncrewed underwater vehicles for covert operations near seabed infrastructure; Western intelligence agencies have long linked it to suspicious activity around undersea cables and pipelines, and both the US and UK have sanctioned it.

terms.zh: 沙蟲（俄羅斯軍事情報駭客組織）
terms.expansion: Sandworm Team (tracked by Cisco Talos, linked to Russia's GRU Unit 74455)

def.zh: 被多家資安業者長期歸因於俄羅斯軍事情報總局(GRU)的國家級駭客組織，過往曾對烏克蘭電網、Olympic Destroyer等目標發動破壞性攻擊，是目前公認能力最強、破壞性最高的國家級APT組織之一。
def.en: A state-sponsored hacking group widely attributed by security vendors to Russia's military intelligence agency (GRU), historically responsible for destructive attacks such as strikes on Ukraine's power grid and the Olympic Destroyer campaign; considered one of the most capable and destructive nation-state APT groups tracked today.

def.zh: 與Sandworm相關聯的模組化惡意程式框架，曾用於劫持WatchGuard等網路設備組成殭屍網路；具備在裝置韌體更新後仍保持存活的持久化能力，是判斷一起入侵是否與Sandworm有關的常見指標之一。
def.en: A modular malware framework associated with Sandworm, previously used to hijack networking devices such as WatchGuard firewalls into a botnet; it can persist across firmware updates, making its presence a common indicator used to link an intrusion back to Sandworm.

def.zh: Cisco用來集中管理旗下防火牆設備群的控制平面軟體；因其設計上對所轄每一台防火牆都握有高權限存取，一旦FMC本身遭入侵，等同一次取得對整個受管防火牆艦隊的控制權。
def.en: Cisco's control-plane software for centrally managing a fleet of its firewall appliances; because it holds high-privilege access over every firewall it manages by design, compromising the FMC itself hands an attacker control over the entire managed fleet at once.

def.zh: 一種堆疊式記憶體技術，能提供AI加速器所需的極高資料頻寬，是先進AI晶片成本結構中占比極高的關鍵零組件；美國自2024年底起收緊對中國出口先進HBM，是中國廠商轉向灰市採購、成本大幅墊高的主因。
def.en: A stacked memory technology that provides the extremely high data bandwidth AI accelerators require, making up a large share of an advanced AI chip's cost structure; US controls tightened on advanced HBM exports to China since late 2024 are the main reason Chinese chipmakers have turned to marked-up grey-market supply.

def.zh: 美國國會每年制定、授權國防部年度預算與政策方向的法案，是國會影響軍事AI使用規則、武器系統採購與出口管制政策的主要立法工具之一，須經參眾兩院協調(conference)出統一文本後生效。
def.en: The annual US law authorizing the Defense Department's budget and policy direction; it is one of Congress's main legislative vehicles for shaping military AI use rules, weapons procurement and export-control policy, and takes effect only after the House and Senate reconcile their versions in conference.

def.zh: 讓一個規模較小的模型,透過大量輸入前沿模型並記錄其輸出,學習模仿該前沿模型行為與能力的訓練技術;原是業界常見的模型壓縮手法,但當蒸餾對象是未經授權存取的競爭對手商用模型、且透過偽造帳號與規避監測的方式大規模進行時,即構成一種新型態的AI供應鏈竊取。
def.en: A training technique in which a smaller model learns to imitate a larger frontier model's behavior and capability by feeding it many inputs and recording its outputs; a common, legitimate model-compression method in the industry — but when carried out at scale against a competitor's commercial model without authorization, using fraudulent accounts and detection evasion, it becomes a new form of AI supply-chain theft.

def.zh: MSP(受管服務供應商)用來透過單一介面集中監控、修補與操作旗下所有客戶端點的軟體平台;因為它天生具備跨組織的高權限存取能力,一旦平台本身遭入侵,等同一次拿到其管理的每一個下游客戶環境的存取權,是供應鏈攻擊的典型高價值目標。
def.en: Software platforms MSPs (managed service providers) use to centrally monitor, patch and operate every client endpoint they manage through one interface; because it inherently holds high-privilege, cross-organization access by design, compromising the platform itself hands an attacker access to every downstream client environment it manages, making it a classic high-value supply-chain target.

def.zh: 用來讓網路上的裝置與伺服器彼此同步時鐘的標準協定;因為多數網路監控與防火牆規則預設信任校時流量、極少對其內容做深度檢查,近年被觀察到遭攻擊者用來偽裝惡意C2(指揮管制)流量,使其混入正常網路噪音而不被察覺。
def.en: The standard protocol devices and servers use to synchronize their clocks over a network; because most network monitoring and firewall rules trust time-sync traffic by default and rarely inspect its content deeply, it has been observed used by attackers to disguise malicious C2 (command-and-control) traffic, blending it into ordinary network noise.

def.zh: 美國在無正式外交關係下,代為處理對台事務與雙邊關係的非營利機構,實質上執行等同大使館的職能;其處長的公開表態,常被視為美方對台政策立場的官方訊號。
def.en: The nonprofit organization the US uses to conduct relations with Taiwan in the absence of formal diplomatic ties, functioning in practice as its de facto embassy; public statements by its director are commonly read as official signals of US policy toward Taiwan.

def.zh: 一套開源專案，讓企業能用同一組介面統一呼叫OpenAI、Anthropic、Google等不同廠商的LLM API，並集中管理金鑰、額度與路由；因為它本身要持有大量上游AI服務的API金鑰，一旦其閘道器程式本身遭入侵，等同一次拿到整個組織對外部AI服務的存取權。
def.en: An open-source project that lets enterprises call OpenAI's, Anthropic's, Google's and other vendors' LLM APIs through one unified interface, centralizing key management, quota control and routing. Because the gateway itself holds API keys to many upstream AI services, compromising the gateway software hands an attacker an organization's entire access to external AI services in one step.

def.zh: 一套讓AI代理人(agent)能標準化地呼叫外部工具、資料來源與服務的通訊協定，近年迅速成為連接LLM與企業內部系統的通用介面；其連線階段(session)若遭偽造或劫持，攻擊者能取得的不只是資料，還包括代理人原本被授權執行的操作能力。
def.en: A standardized communication protocol that lets AI agents call external tools, data sources and services, and has rapidly become a common interface linking LLMs to enterprise systems. If its session layer is forged or hijacked, an attacker gains not just data access but the operational actions the agent was authorized to perform.

def.zh: 美國聯準會下設、負責決定政策利率與公開市場操作的核心決策機構，每年定期召開會議，其利率決定是全球美元計價資產定價的錨點之一；地緣衝突若推高油價，往往會直接反映在FOMC對通膨路徑的判斷上。
def.en: The Federal Reserve's core policy-setting body, which decides the federal funds rate and open-market operations at scheduled meetings throughout the year; its rate decisions anchor pricing across dollar-denominated assets globally. Geopolitical conflict that pushes oil prices higher tends to feed directly into the FOMC's read on the inflation path.

def.zh: 資安領域用來訓練與測試攻防技巧的模擬競賽或環境，參與者需在受控範圍內尋找漏洞、奪取「旗標」以證明入侵成功；AI 安全評測常借用此格式作為紅隊測試場景。
def.en: A simulated competition or environment used in security research to practice offensive/defensive skills, where participants find vulnerabilities and capture a 'flag' to prove successful compromise; AI safety evaluations increasingly borrow this format as a red-teaming scenario.

def.zh: 攻擊者在未經授權的情況下，於目標系統上執行任意程式碼的漏洞利用類型，通常是資安事件中最高等級的危害之一，因為它讓攻擊者取得系統的實質控制權。
def.en: A vulnerability class in which an attacker executes arbitrary code on a target system without authorization — typically among the highest-severity outcomes in a security incident because it gives the attacker practical control of the system.

def.zh: 無人操作的水面艦艇，可執行偵察、反水雷、攻擊或後勤任務，近年因烏俄戰場經驗與成本優勢，成為海上不對稱作戰的重點投資方向。
def.en: An uncrewed surface vessel used for reconnaissance, mine countermeasures, strike, or logistics roles; its low cost relative to crewed vessels has made it a priority investment for asymmetric naval warfare, reinforced by lessons from the Russia-Ukraine war.

def.zh: 無人操作的地面載具，可搭載武器、感測器或補給物資，近期戰場上出現由無人機空投部署 UGV 直接投入接觸線的新戰術。
def.en: An uncrewed ground vehicle that can carry weapons, sensors, or supplies; recent battlefield use includes drone-delivered deployment of UGVs directly to the contact line.

def.zh: 操作者透過機載攝影機即時影像視角遙控的無人機，因取得容易、成本低廉，已成為現代戰場上大量消耗、高頻次使用的攻擊性武器平台。
def.en: A drone piloted using a real-time first-person camera feed from the aircraft itself; low cost and easy availability have made it a high-volume, attritable strike platform on modern battlefields.

def.zh: 工業控制系統中用來自動化控制機械、閥門或製程的專用電腦，常見於水務、電力與製造業現場，若直接暴露在公開網路上且未加防護，是關鍵基礎設施最常見的入侵入口之一。
def.en: A specialized industrial computer used to automate control of machinery, valves, or processes — common in water, power, and manufacturing environments; when left directly exposed on the public internet without protection, it is one of the most common entry points for critical-infrastructure intrusions.

def.zh: 操作人員用來監控與操作工業控制系統（如 PLC）的介面軟硬體，同樣經常因暴露在公開網路且缺乏驗證機制，而成為攻擊者的可乘之機。
def.en: The interface hardware/software operators use to monitor and control industrial systems such as PLCs; like PLCs, HMIs are frequently exposed on the public internet without adequate authentication, making them a common attacker entry point.

def.zh: 船舶依國際規範定期廣播自身位置、航速與航向等資訊的追蹤系統，原用於航行安全，近年也被情報與海事分析機構用來比對船隻行為模式、識別異常活動。
def.en: A tracking system requiring vessels to periodically broadcast their position, speed, and heading under international maritime rules; originally for navigational safety, it is now also used by intelligence and maritime-analysis firms to profile vessel behavior and flag anomalies.

def.zh: 沿海國家依《聯合國海洋法公約》對其海岸線外 200 海浬內水域享有的資源開發與管轄權區域，但不等同於領海主權，外國船舶原則上仍享有航行自由。
def.en: A zone extending 200 nautical miles from a coastal state's shoreline, under UNCLOS, over which that state holds resource and jurisdictional rights — distinct from territorial sovereignty, since foreign vessels generally retain freedom of navigation within it.

def.zh: 一國基於空防需要，在其領空外自行劃設、要求進入航空器需先行識別或通報的空域，不具有國際法上的領空效力，但違反規定常被視為政治與軍事信號。
def.en: An airspace zone a state unilaterally declares beyond its sovereign airspace, requiring aircraft entering it to identify themselves or report in advance for air-defense purposes; it carries no sovereign status under international law, but violations are routinely read as political/military signaling.

def.zh: 美國商務部下轄、負責執行出口管制與技術轉讓審查的機構，是美中科技／半導體出口管制政策的主要執法單位。
def.en: The US Department of Commerce agency responsible for enforcing export controls and reviewing technology transfers — the primary enforcement body behind US semiconductor/technology export-control policy toward China.

def.zh: 軍事脈絡中指用於下達指令、協調分散單位並維持作戰控制的節點或系統；在資安脈絡中則指攻擊者用來遙控受駭裝置、下達指令並回收竊取資料的伺服器基礎設施。
def.en: In military doctrine, the nodes and systems used to issue orders, coordinate dispersed units, and maintain operational control; in cybersecurity, the server infrastructure an attacker uses to remotely direct compromised devices and retrieve exfiltrated data.

def.zh: 內建於主機板或處理器中的安全晶片／韌體模組，用於產生與保管加密金鑰、驗證開機流程完整性，並向作業系統或遠端服務證明裝置未遭竄改；是零信任架構常見的硬體信任根。
def.en: A security chip or firmware module built into a motherboard or processor that generates and safeguards cryptographic keys, verifies boot-process integrity, and attests to an operating system or remote service that a device has not been tampered with — a common hardware root of trust in zero-trust architectures.

def.zh: 兩國海軍艦艇在海上偶遇或途經彼此水域時，依國際海軍慣例進行的簡短禮節性協同操演（如通信、隊形、海上補給），性質上屬於禮貌性海軍外交，不代表雙邊已建立正式軍事同盟或事先規劃的演習關係。
def.en: A brief, courtesy-based coordination drill (e.g., communications, formation-keeping, underway replenishment) conducted between two navies' vessels that encounter each other at sea or transit through each other's waters, following international naval custom — routine maritime diplomacy, not evidence of a formal alliance or a pre-planned bilateral exercise.

def.zh: 美軍作戰型聯合司令部之一，負責規劃與執行太空作戰，涵蓋衛星防護、太空態勢感知，以及對敵方太空能力的反制行動。
def.en: One of the US military's combatant commands, responsible for planning and conducting space operations, including satellite protection, space domain awareness, and counter-operations against adversary space capabilities.

def.zh: 專門設計用來摧毀、致盲或干擾敵方衛星的武器系統，可分為動能（直接撞擊摧毀）與非動能（電子干擾、雷射致盲、網路攻擊等）兩類。
def.en: A weapon system designed to destroy, blind, or disable an adversary's satellites, spanning kinetic (direct-impact destruction) and non-kinetic (jamming, laser dazzling, cyberattack) methods.

def.zh: 由數百至數千顆小型衛星組成、部署於低地球軌道的大型星系（如Starlink），因數量龐大而具備抗毀性，同時也對傳統反衛星戰略構成新的挑戰。
def.en: A large satellite constellation of hundreds to thousands of small satellites deployed in low Earth orbit (e.g., Starlink); its sheer numbers make it resilient to attrition and pose a distinct challenge to traditional anti-satellite strategy.

def.zh: 美軍各聯合作戰司令部定期向五角大廈提交、用以排序未來預算週期所需武器系統與能力需求的正式文件，是影響國防採購優先順序的關鍵輸入。
def.en: A formal document each US combatant command periodically submits to the Pentagon ranking the weapons systems and capabilities it needs for upcoming budget cycles — a key input shaping defense-procurement priorities.

def.zh: US商務部用來將受管制物項（如特定無人機、半導體設備）歸類，以決定其出口許可要求的編號系統，是出口管制執法的基本分類單位。
def.en: A classification code the US Commerce Department assigns to controlled items (e.g., certain drones, semiconductor equipment) to determine their export-licensing requirements — the basic unit of export-control enforcement.

def.zh: 威脅情報中描述行為者「習慣怎麼做事」的抽象層：戰術是目的、技術是手段、程序是具體執行步驟。在 Pyramid of Pain 中位居頂端，因為攻擊者更換 TTP 的成本遠高於更換工具或基礎設施，因此長期被當成歸因最可靠的依據。
def.en: The layer of threat intelligence describing how an actor habitually operates: tactics are goals, techniques are means, procedures are concrete execution steps. It sits at the top of the Pyramid of Pain because changing TTPs costs an attacker far more than changing tools or infrastructure, which is why it has long been treated as the most reliable basis for attribution.

terms.zh: 對抗戰術與技術知識庫
terms.expansion: MITRE Adversarial Tactics, Techniques, and Common Knowledge

def.zh: MITRE 維護的公開對抗行為分類框架，把攻擊行為編碼為 14 種戰術與數百項技術／子技術，並附上各已知威脅群組的側寫，是目前業界比對與交換威脅情報的共通語言。
def.en: MITRE's public taxonomy of adversary behavior, encoding attacks into 14 tactics and hundreds of techniques and sub-techniques, with profiles for known threat groups. It is the industry's common language for comparing and exchanging threat intelligence.

def.zh: 泛指資源充足、目標明確且長期潛伏的攻擊群組，通常有國家背景。業界慣以編號（如 APT28、APT41）指稱特定群集，但編號代表的是「一組被觀察到的行為特徵」，不必然等同某個具體組織。
def.en: A well-resourced, goal-directed intrusion group that maintains long-term access, typically state-linked. The industry refers to specific clusters by number (APT28, APT41), but a number denotes an observed behavioral cluster and does not necessarily map to a single concrete organization.

def.zh: 蒐集、分析並產出關於威脅行為者能力、意圖與手法的情報產品，用於支撐偵測、獵捕與決策。其效力高度依賴「行為者留下可辨識且穩定的痕跡」這個前提。
def.en: The collection, analysis and production of intelligence on threat actors' capabilities, intentions and methods, used to support detection, hunting and decision-making. Its effectiveness depends heavily on the premise that actors leave recognizable and stable traces.

def.zh: 行為者為隱藏自身身分、位置與意圖所採取的作業紀律，例如基礎設施輪替、時區偽裝、語言痕跡清理。OPSEC 習慣本身往往帶有訓練體系的特徵，因此長期是歸因的重要線索。
def.en: The operational discipline an actor uses to conceal identity, location and intent — rotating infrastructure, masking time zones, scrubbing language artifacts. OPSEC habits tend to carry the marks of a training system, which is why they have long been a valuable attribution clue.

def.zh: 可用於偵測入侵的具體技術痕跡，如 IP 位址、網域、檔案雜湊值。IOC 的價值在於可被第三方獨立驗證與複現；一份不釋出 IOC 的威脅報告，在證據等級上等同無法交叉查核的單方陳述。
def.en: Concrete technical artifacts used to detect an intrusion — IP addresses, domains, file hashes. Their value lies in being independently verifiable and reproducible by third parties; a threat report that releases no IOCs is, evidentially, an uncorroborated single-party assertion.

def.zh: 以大規模文本訓練的生成式模型，可依自然語言指令產出文字與程式碼。當它被嵌入具備工具呼叫與自主規劃能力的框架時即成為「代理人」，能在無人逐步指示的情況下推進多階段任務。
def.en: A generative model trained on large text corpora that produces text and code from natural-language instruction. Embedded in a framework with tool-calling and autonomous planning, it becomes an agent capable of advancing multi-stage tasks without step-by-step human direction.

def.zh: 軟體之間的呼叫介面。在 AI 供應鏈的脈絡中特別重要，因為透過 API 存取模型會在供應商端留下帳號、金鑰與計費紀錄——這正是本報告所稱「供應層」可被觀察的原因。
def.en: The calling interface between software systems. It matters especially in the AI supply chain because accessing a model via API leaves account, key and billing records on the provider's side — precisely what makes the provisioning layer observable.

def.zh: 原用於圖形運算、現為 AI 訓練與推論主力的平行運算晶片。是美國對中出口管制的核心標的，也是「租用算力」這條規避路徑的實體基礎。
def.en: A parallel-computing chip originally for graphics, now the workhorse of AI training and inference. It is the core target of US export controls toward China and the physical basis of the compute-rental workaround.

def.zh: Google 旗下整合 Mandiant 與自有遙測的威脅情報單位，2025 年起持續發布 AI 濫用相關研究，包括首批在執行期呼叫模型即時生成程式碼的惡意程式家族。
def.en: Google's threat intelligence unit combining Mandiant with Google's own telemetry. Since 2025 it has published research on AI misuse, including the first malware families observed calling models at runtime to generate code just-in-time.

def.zh: Microsoft 的威脅情報單位，以天氣／礦物命名法（如 Sleet 指北韓、Typhoon 指中國）標示國家關聯群集，其公開評估在 AI 是否構成自主威脅的辯論中傾向保守。
def.en: Microsoft's threat intelligence unit, which labels state-linked clusters with a weather-and-mineral naming scheme (Sleet for North Korea, Typhoon for China). Its public assessments lean conservative in the debate over whether AI constitutes an autonomous threat.

def.zh: 美國商務部管轄的兩用物項出口法規體系，由 BIS 執行。其對「出口」的定義以實體移轉與技術釋出為核心，因此遠端提供雲端運算長期不被視為出口事件——這正是 Remote Access Security Act 要填補的缺口。
def.en: The US Commerce Department's dual-use export regime, administered by BIS. Its definition of export centers on physical transfer and technology release, which is why remotely providing cloud compute has long not counted as an export event — the gap the Remote Access Security Act seeks to close.

def.zh: 以租用方式提供運算、儲存與網路等基礎資源的雲端模式。因為使用者取得的是「存取權」而非硬體本身，它成為既有以貨物為中心的出口管制體系最難處理的形態。
def.en: A cloud model providing compute, storage and networking on a rental basis. Because the customer obtains access rights rather than the hardware itself, it is the form that goods-centric export control regimes handle worst.

def.zh: 以訂閱方式透過網路提供軟體功能的模式。與 IaaS 同樣涉及「能力以服務形式跨境流動」，因此一併被納入遠端存取管制的立法討論範圍。
def.en: Software delivered over the network on a subscription basis. Like IaaS it involves capability crossing borders as a service, which is why it is swept into the same legislative debate over remote-access controls.

def.zh: 源自金融反洗錢的客戶身分查核義務，近年被提議移植到雲端與 AI 服務業者身上，要求其查驗境外客戶身分並通報。這是把管制責任從貨物流向轉移到服務關係的典型設計。
def.en: A customer-identification duty originating in financial anti-money-laundering rules, recently proposed for cloud and AI service providers, requiring them to verify and report foreign customers. It is the archetypal design for shifting regulatory responsibility from goods flows to service relationships.

def.zh: 美國行政機關在正式訂定法規前公告草案並徵求公眾意見的程序。NPRM 未必會定案——BIS 於 2024 年針對 IaaS 業者的 KYC 提案即從未成為最終規則。
def.en: The US administrative procedure for publishing a draft rule and inviting public comment before finalization. An NPRM need not become law — BIS's 2024 proposal for IaaS provider KYC never became a final rule.

terms.expansion: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China

def.zh: 中國主管對外貿易與出口管制的部門，負責維護出口管制清單與兩用物項許可。2026 年起就是否將 AI 模型權重、訓練資料與晶片設計納入管制向產業界徵詢意見。
def.en: China's ministry responsible for foreign trade and export control, maintaining control lists and dual-use licensing. From 2026 it has been consulting industry on whether to bring AI model weights, training data and chip designs under control.

def.zh: 歐盟 AI Act 中的法律類別，指可適用於多種下游任務的基礎模型。其提供者須負擔技術文件、著作權政策與訓練資料摘要等義務，義務自 2025 年 8 月生效、2026 年 8 月起進入執法階段。
def.en: A legal category in the EU AI Act covering foundation models applicable to many downstream tasks. Providers carry obligations on technical documentation, copyright policy and training-data summaries; the obligations applied from August 2025 and entered enforcement in August 2026.

terms.zh: 雲端與人工智慧發展法

def.zh: 歐盟 2026 年通過的雲端主權法規，建立四級主權框架，判準包含歐盟境內處理、獨立於第三國控制、供應鏈透明度與獨立稽核。其動機是降低對美國雲的依賴，而非拒止特定對手。
def.en: The EU's 2026 cloud sovereignty regulation, establishing a four-tier framework whose criteria include EU-based processing, independence from third-country control, supply-chain transparency and independent audit. Its motive is reducing dependence on US cloud rather than denying a specific adversary.

def.zh: 由 MITRE 維護的標準化漏洞編號系統，為每一個公開揭露的軟體或韌體安全漏洞分配唯一識別碼，讓廠商、研究者與政府機構能用同一個代號交叉引用同一項漏洞。
def.en: A standardized vulnerability-numbering system maintained by MITRE, assigning a unique identifier to each publicly disclosed software or firmware security flaw so vendors, researchers, and government agencies can cross-reference the same vulnerability by a common label.

def.zh: 美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）維護的漏洞清單，只收錄已被證實在實際攻擊中遭利用的漏洞，一經列入即對聯邦機構課以強制修補期限，是判斷某漏洞是否已從理論風險變成現實威脅的官方指標。
def.en: A vulnerability list maintained by the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), containing only flaws confirmed to have been exploited in real-world attacks; listing triggers a mandatory remediation deadline for federal agencies, making it an official signal that a vulnerability has moved from theoretical risk to active threat.

def.zh: 美國陸軍研發的終端高空區域防禦系統，用於在飛彈飛行末端、大氣層內外攔截短程至中程彈道飛彈。
def.en: A US Army missile-defense system designed to intercept short- to medium-range ballistic missiles during their terminal phase, both inside and just outside the atmosphere.

def.zh: 伊朗一支獨立於正規軍之外的精銳軍事組織，同時掌控大量經濟資源與海外准軍事行動，是伊朗地緣政治與網路行動的關鍵執行者。
def.en: An elite Iranian military organization operating parallel to the regular armed forces, controlling significant economic assets and overseeing many of Iran's overseas paramilitary and cyber operations.

def.zh: 用於監控與控制實體設備、製程與基礎設施運作的硬體與軟體系統（如 PLC、SCADA），與管理資訊的 IT 系統相對而言，一旦遭入侵可能直接造成實體損害。
def.en: The hardware and software systems (e.g., PLCs, SCADA) that monitor and control physical equipment, processes, and infrastructure — as distinct from IT systems that manage information — where compromise can cause direct physical harm.

def.zh: 一種犯罪商業模式，勒索軟體開發者將工具與基礎設施出租給附屬犯罪者（affiliates）使用，雙方按比例分潤贖金。
def.en: A criminal business model in which ransomware developers lease their tools and infrastructure to affiliate operators, splitting ransom proceeds by an agreed share.

def.zh: 專門入侵並出售企業網路初始存取權限給其他犯罪集團（如勒索軟體團夥）的中間人角色，是網路犯罪供應鏈中的分工節點。
def.en: An intermediary who breaches organizations and sells the resulting initial network access to other criminal groups (such as ransomware operators) — a specialized node in the cybercrime supply chain.

def.zh: 用來為軟體漏洞的嚴重程度打分（0–10分）的產業標準系統，分數越高代表可被利用造成的危害越大；但分數本身只反映理論嚴重性，不代表該漏洞是否已被實際利用，這正是 CISA 後續改用「已遭利用證據」取代單純 CVSS 分數作為修補優先順序判準的原因。
def.en: An industry-standard system for scoring the severity of a software vulnerability on a 0–10 scale, with higher scores indicating greater potential impact; the score reflects theoretical severity only, not whether the flaw has actually been exploited — the reason CISA later moved to an exploit-evidence model rather than raw CVSS scores for patch prioritization.

def.zh: 射程通常在1,000公里以內的彈道飛彈，北韓近年密集試射的主力機型多屬此類，用於評估其對日本、南韓等區域目標的即時打擊能力與飛彈量產速度。
def.en: A ballistic missile with a range typically under 1,000 km; most of North Korea's frequent recent test launches fall into this category, used to gauge its immediate strike capability against regional targets such as Japan and South Korea and the pace of its missile production.

def.zh: 美國 CISA 對聯邦文職機關（FCEB）發出、具強制執行力的網路安全指令，要求在指定期限內完成特定修補或防護措施；2026年6月生效的 BOD 26-04 以「已遭利用證據」取代單純 CVSS 分數，作為決定修補優先順序與期限的判準。
def.en: A binding cybersecurity directive CISA issues to US federal civilian executive branch (FCEB) agencies, requiring specific remediation or protective actions within a set deadline; BOD 26-04, effective June 2026, replaced flat CVSS-based severity with an exploit-evidence model for setting patch priority and deadlines.

def.zh: 北韓最新型的短程彈道飛彈,彈體較先前的KN-23更長、彈頭更重(可達2,500公斤),2026年8月首度被證實部署於俄羅斯境內、用於實際打擊烏克蘭。
def.en: North Korea's newest short-range ballistic missile, longer and heavier-warheaded (up to 2,500 kg) than the earlier KN-23; first confirmed to be deployed inside Russia for actual strikes on Ukraine in August 2026.

def.zh: 可將飛彈由水平運輸姿態豎起至發射姿態的機動式車輛平台,讓彈道飛彈部隊得以在發射後迅速轉移、提高存活率,是機動彈道飛彈系統不可或缺的支援載具。
def.en: A mobile vehicle platform that transports a missile and erects it from horizontal to launch position; lets ballistic missile units relocate quickly after firing to improve survivability, and is an indispensable support vehicle for any road-mobile ballistic missile system.

terms.zh: 烏克蘭國防部情報總局
terms.expansion: Holovne Upravlinnya Rozvidky (Defence Intelligence of Ukraine)

def.zh: 烏克蘭國防部下轄的軍事情報機構,負責對外情報蒐集與特種作戰,是俄烏戰爭中烏方對外公開俄軍與其盟友(如北韓)動態的主要官方消息來源之一;作為衝突當事一方,其公開評估具高度情報價值但非中立第三方確認。
def.en: Ukraine's Ministry of Defense military intelligence agency, responsible for foreign intelligence collection and special operations; one of the main official sources through which Ukraine publicizes Russian and allied (e.g., North Korean) military activity during the war — a valuable but non-neutral source, since Ukraine is a party to the conflict.

terms.zh: 未分類威脅叢集（Mandiant/Google命名編號）

def.zh: Mandiant(現為Google旗下)用來標示「已觀察到一組具內部一致性的入侵活動、但尚未有足夠證據將其升級為正式命名威脅組織(如APT編號)」的暫時性編號,UNC叢集可能後續被合併、升級或證實與已知組織相關。
def.en: A provisional designation Mandiant (now part of Google) assigns to a cluster of intrusion activity that shows internal consistency but lacks sufficient evidence to be promoted to a formally named threat group (e.g., an APT number); a UNC cluster may later be merged, upgraded, or confirmed to overlap with a known group.

def.zh: 允許使用者授權第三方應用程式存取自己帳號特定資源、卻不必把帳號密碼交給該應用程式的開放標準協定;因為授權當下使用者看到的確實是官方登入頁面,近年被威脅行為者用來將竊取存取權杖偽裝成一次正常登入,使傳統「檢查是否為官方網域」的防禦直覺失效。
def.en: An open standard protocol letting a user authorize a third-party app to access specific account resources without handing over the account password; because the login screen shown at the moment of authorization is genuinely the official one, threat actors have increasingly abused it to disguise access-token theft as an ordinary login, defeating the standard user instinct of checking whether the domain is official.

def.zh: 透過網路而非實體連接,遠端推送並安裝韌體或軟體更新的機制,廣泛用於物聯網裝置、車用系統與行動裝置;因為使用者通常預設信任這條管道且不會逐次審查更新內容,一旦該管道本身遭劫持,就會成為大規模、難以逐台稽核的惡意程式散布途徑。
def.en: A mechanism for remotely pushing and installing firmware or software updates over a network rather than a physical connection, widely used in IoT devices, automotive systems, and mobile devices; because users typically trust this channel by default and rarely scrutinize individual updates, a hijacked OTA channel becomes a large-scale malware distribution vector that is hard to audit device by device.

def.zh: 在端點上常駐代理程式、持續蒐集行程與檔案等行為遙測並支援回溯調查的防護技術。其前提是該資產能安裝代理程式——虛擬化管理平面、邊界設備與 PLC 多半不支援，形成結構性盲區。
def.en: Security tooling that runs a resident agent on an endpoint, continuously collecting process and file behaviour telemetry and supporting retrospective investigation. It presupposes that the asset can host an agent — virtualization management planes, edge appliances and PLCs mostly cannot, which creates a structural blind spot.

def.zh: 監控與操作實體製程的系統總稱，涵蓋 SCADA、DCS 與 PLC。生命週期以十年計、變更窗口以年計，且多數在設計時未預期直接連上網際網路。
def.en: Umbrella term for systems that monitor and operate physical processes, covering SCADA, DCS and PLCs. Lifecycles run in decades and change windows in years, and most were never designed on the assumption of direct internet connectivity.

terms.zh: VMware ESXi 虛擬化管理程式

def.zh: VMware 直接安裝在實體伺服器上的第一型 hypervisor。拿下 ESXi 等於同時掌握其上所有虛擬機，因此成為勒索軟體加密資料存放區的首選目標，而它本身不支援一般 EDR 代理程式。
def.en: VMware's type-1 hypervisor installed directly on physical servers. Controlling ESXi means controlling every virtual machine on it, which makes it the preferred target for ransomware that encrypts datastores wholesale — and it cannot host a conventional EDR agent.

def.zh: VMware vCenter 的預封裝虛擬設備形式，底層跑 Photon OS。它是 vSphere 環境的集中控制平面，取得其權限即可管理整個虛擬化叢集；其核心層 auditd 存在，但遠端轉發預設關閉。
def.en: The pre-packaged virtual-appliance form of VMware vCenter, running Photon OS underneath. It is the centralized control plane for a vSphere environment, so admin rights on it mean control of the whole virtualization cluster. Kernel-level auditd exists on it, but remote forwarding is disabled by default.

def.zh: VCSA 上獨立於 vSphere Client 的管理網頁介面（TCP 5480），用於網路、憑證與防火牆等設備層設定。其防火牆由它所保護的應用程式自身管理，構成循環依賴。
def.en: The appliance-level web management interface on VCSA (TCP 5480), separate from the vSphere Client, used for network, certificate and firewall settings. Its firewall is administered by the very application it protects, producing a circular dependency.

def.zh: Siemens S7 系列 PLC 使用的專有通訊協定，用於工程軟體與控制器之間的程式下載與資料存取。多數版本缺乏強制認證，可對記憶體、組態與階梯邏輯進行讀寫。
def.en: The proprietary protocol Siemens S7-series PLCs use for program download and data access between engineering software and the controller. Most versions lack enforced authentication, allowing reads and writes to memory, configuration and ladder logic.

def.zh: Linux 核心層的稽核子系統使用者空間元件，在系統呼叫層級記錄行為，不受 shell 歷史被清除影響。在 VCSA 上預設只寫本機，需手動開啟 audisp 橋接才會送到遠端。
def.en: The user-space component of the Linux kernel audit subsystem, recording behaviour at the syscall level and therefore unaffected by cleared shell history. On VCSA it writes locally by default; the audisp bridge must be enabled manually before anything reaches a remote collector.

terms.zh: 資安資訊與事件管理平台

def.zh: 集中收容、關聯與長期保存各來源日誌的平台。對無法安裝代理程式的資產而言，遠端轉發到 SIEM 是唯一能在本機遭抹除後倖存的證據途徑。
def.en: A platform that centrally ingests, correlates and retains logs from many sources over time. For assets that cannot host an agent, forwarding to a SIEM is the only path by which evidence survives the wiping of the local disk.

def.zh: 從漏洞修補程式發布到在野出現實際利用之間的平均間隔。此值為負代表利用先於修補程式存在，使任何以修補可用性為起點的期限失去意義。
def.en: The average interval between a patch being released and exploitation appearing in the wild. A negative value means exploitation precedes the patch's existence, which voids any deadline measured from patch availability.

def.zh: Verizon 每年發布的入侵事件統計報告，以初始存取途徑、行為者類型與產業分布為主要切面，是業界最常被引用的長期基線資料之一。樣本偏向已進入調查程序的事件。
def.en: Verizon's annual breach statistics report, cut primarily by initial access vector, actor type and industry, and one of the industry's most-cited long-run baselines. Its sample skews toward incidents that reached a formal investigation.

def.zh: 列舉一項軟體或產品所含全部元件與相依項的結構化清單。其政策價值在於讓漏洞公告發布時，能反查哪些產品受影響——即把「不知道自己用了什麼」轉為可查詢的問題。
def.en: A structured inventory of every component and dependency inside a piece of software or a product. Its policy value is that when an advisory lands, affected products can be looked up in reverse — turning "we don't know what we're running" into a queryable question.

def.zh: 歐盟針對含數位要素產品的橫向資安法規，義務落在製造商而非使用者：正在被利用的漏洞須於 24 小時內通報，並在支援期內持續提供安全更新。管制點是產品供給，不是部署。
def.en: The EU's horizontal cybersecurity regulation for products with digital elements, placing obligations on manufacturers rather than users: actively exploited vulnerabilities must be reported within 24 hours, and security updates supplied across the declared support period. Its control point is product supply, not deployment.

def.zh: 歐盟層級的網路安全機構，負責認證框架、威脅情勢報告與跨國協調。在 CRA 下成為製造商通報正在被利用漏洞的接收端之一。
def.en: The EU-level cybersecurity agency responsible for certification frameworks, threat-landscape reporting and cross-border coordination. Under the CRA it becomes one of the recipients of manufacturers' actively-exploited-vulnerability reports.

terms.zh: 電腦資安事件應變小組

def.zh: 負責接收通報、協調應變與發布警訊的組織單位，多數國家設有國家級 CSIRT。在 CRA 架構下與 ENISA 並列為製造商的法定通報對象。
def.en: An organizational unit that receives reports, coordinates response and issues warnings; most countries maintain a national-level CSIRT. Under the CRA they sit alongside ENISA as statutory recipients of manufacturer reports.

def.zh: 美國聯邦政府中不含國防部與情報體系的行政機關集合，是 CISA 具約束力作業指令（BOD）的法定適用對象。其合規數字常被當成整體產業實務的領先指標。
def.en: The set of US federal executive agencies excluding the Defense Department and the intelligence community — the statutory addressees of CISA's Binding Operational Directives. Their compliance figures are often read as a leading indicator of broader industry practice.

def.zh: 中國法律體系中的專有範疇，指一旦遭破壞即嚴重危害國家安全、國計民生的網路設施與資訊系統，適用資料在地化、採購安全審查與更高罰則等加重義務。
def.en: A defined category in Chinese law covering network facilities and information systems whose disruption would seriously endanger national security or public welfare. Designation brings heightened obligations including data localization, procurement security review and higher penalties.

def.zh: 掌握整個環境控制權的最高權限資產，如網域控制站、身分提供者與虛擬化管理平面。其特徵是被攻破即等同全域失守，而這類資產通常無法安裝一般端點防護。
def.en: The highest-privilege assets that control an entire environment — domain controllers, identity providers, virtualization management planes. Compromise of one is equivalent to loss of the whole estate, and this class typically cannot host conventional endpoint defenses.

def.zh: 以網路流量而非主機代理程式為觀測基礎的偵測技術。在無法安裝 EDR 的資產上，它是少數仍可取得的遙測來源，但解析度低於主機層的系統呼叫級證據。
def.en: Detection built on network traffic rather than host agents. On assets that cannot run EDR it is one of the few remaining telemetry sources, but its resolution is lower than host-level syscall evidence.

def.zh: 程式釋放一塊記憶體後，仍繼續透過殘留指標存取或寫入該記憶體的漏洞類型；攻擊者可利用釋放與再存取之間的時間差，讓該記憶體被重新配置為攻擊者可控的內容，進而劫持程式執行流程。
def.en: A vulnerability class in which a program continues to access or write memory through a dangling pointer after that memory has been freed; an attacker can exploit the gap between free and reuse to have the memory reallocated with attacker-controlled content, hijacking program execution.

def.zh: 攻擊者在已取得目標系統低權限存取後，進一步將自身權限提升至系統管理者或核心層級的漏洞利用類型；與需要遠端網路存取的 RCE 不同，LPE 的前提是攻擊者已經在機器上，價值在於把「一個帳號」變成「整台機器」。
def.en: A vulnerability class in which an attacker who already has low-privilege access to a system escalates that access to administrator or kernel level; unlike RCE, which requires remote network access, LPE presupposes the attacker is already on the box, and its value is turning 'one account' into 'the whole machine'.

def.zh: 負責即時監控、分析與回應資安事件的組織單位，通常操作 EDR、SIEM 等偵測工具。其有效性不只取決於工具是否到位，更取決於告警分流的標準作業程序與分析師是否有權限對可疑活動採取行動——工具偵測到，不代表組織會回應。
def.en: The organizational unit responsible for real-time monitoring, analysis and response to security events, typically operating EDR and SIEM tooling. Its effectiveness depends not just on whether the tools are in place but on whether standard operating procedures for alert triage exist and analysts have the authority to act on suspicious activity — a tool detecting something does not mean the organization responds to it.

def.zh: 搭載大型雷達與指管系統的飛機，用於在空中長時間監控廣域空域、偵測並引導對敵機或飛彈的攔截，是現代空戰體系裡協調戰機、延伸雷達視距的關鍵節點。
def.en: An aircraft carrying a large radar and command-and-control suite that monitors a wide area of airspace for extended periods, detecting threats and directing intercepts; a key node in modern air-combat systems for coordinating fighters and extending radar horizon beyond ground-based sensors.

def.zh: 英國皇家海軍設立、向商船通報中東與紅海等高風險海域安全狀況的機構，是該海域船運業者最常引用的獨立監測消息來源之一，但其通報基於船東回報與自身監測，並非對事件責任歸屬做出判斷。
def.en: A UK Royal Navy-run body that issues security notices to merchant shipping in high-risk waters such as the Middle East and Red Sea; one of the shipping industry's most commonly cited independent monitoring sources for that region, though its reports are based on shipowner accounts and its own monitoring and do not assign responsibility for an incident.

terms.zh: QTFY(中國國家背景商用駭客團伙代號)

def.zh: 美國司法部與FBI用來指稱一支受雇於中國民營企業南京新九維網路科技公司、經營QScan/QTRouter駭客平台團伙的代號。其活動已持續逾8年,法院文件將中國國家安全部與解放軍列為其付費客戶,是「攻擊者即存取關係」在殭屍網路層級的具體案例。
def.en: A designation the US Justice Department and FBI use for a group employed by Chinese private company Nanjing Xinjiuwei Network Technology Co. to run the QScan/QTRouter hacking platforms. Active for over eight years, court documents name China's Ministry of State Security and the PLA as its paying customers — a concrete botnet-layer instance of 'the attacker as an access relationship.'

def.zh: 中國負責對外情報蒐集、反間諜與國內安全的部級機構,兼具情報機關與國安警察職能;近年多起網路間諜活動的法院文件與威脅情報報告將其列為特定駭客團伙的付費客戶或指導單位。
def.en: China's ministry-level agency responsible for foreign intelligence collection, counterespionage and domestic security, combining the functions of an intelligence service and a security police force; recent court filings and threat-intelligence reports have named it as the paying customer or directing body behind specific hacking groups.

def.zh: 台灣負責國防政策、軍事採購與部隊管理的內閣部會;在無人機特別預算爭議中,是行政院版本原定的主管機關,在野黨版本則將主管機關改為經濟部,僅軍事採購部分仍歸其管轄。
def.en: Taiwan's cabinet-level ministry responsible for defense policy, military procurement and force management; in the drone special-budget dispute, it was the lead authority under the Cabinet's original bill, while the opposition's version shifted lead authority to the Ministry of Economic Affairs, leaving MND responsible only for the military-procurement portion.

def.zh: 台灣負責產業政策、貿易與經濟事務的內閣部會;在野黨主導通過的無人機特別預算版本將其列為主管機關(軍事採購部分除外),反映該版本更側重產業扶植而非純軍事需求的立法邏輯。
def.en: Taiwan's cabinet-level ministry responsible for industrial policy, trade and economic affairs; the opposition-led version of the drone special budget designated it as lead authority (excluding the military-procurement portion), reflecting a legislative logic weighted more toward industrial development than pure military requirements.

def.zh: 1980年締結的國際武器管制公約,透過附加議定書限制或禁止特定造成過度傷害或濫殺濫傷的常規武器;其定期審議會議(2026年11月於日內瓦召開)是目前討論致命性自主武器系統拘束性規範最主要的國際場域,但因採共識決,進展長期緩慢。
def.en: An international arms-control convention concluded in 1980 that uses additional protocols to restrict or ban specific conventional weapons deemed to cause excessive injury or indiscriminate harm; its periodic review conference (next held in Geneva in November 2026) is the primary international venue for negotiating binding rules on lethal autonomous weapons systems, though progress has long been slow due to its consensus-based decision rule.

def.zh: 無需即時人類操作介入、可自主偵測、選定並攻擊目標的武器系統;其治理爭議核心在於機器是否能在戰場情境中正確判斷戰鬥員是否已喪失戰鬥能力或已投降,目前是CCW框架下政府專家組討論的主要議題。
def.en: Weapon systems capable of autonomously detecting, selecting and engaging targets without real-time human operator intervention; the core governance dispute is whether a machine can correctly judge battlefield context such as a combatant surrendering or being incapacitated, and it is the central subject under discussion in the CCW's Group of Governmental Experts.

terms.zh: 中國國家發展和改革委員會

def.zh: 中國宏觀經濟管理機關，職權涵蓋產業政策、投資審批與資源分配；在先進晶片進口案例中，即使美方已核發出口許可，實際能運進中國境內或部署使用的數量仍取決於 NDRC 這一層中國國內審批，形成美方管制之外的第二道關卡。
def.en: China's macroeconomic management agency, with authority spanning industrial policy, investment approval and resource allocation; in the case of advanced chip imports, even after a US export license is granted, how many units actually enter or get deployed in China still depends on this domestic Chinese approval layer — a second gate sitting outside US export control.

def.zh: 美軍地理型聯合作戰司令部之一，轄區涵蓋中東、中亞與部分北非（包括 Iran、Iraq 與波灣各國），總部位於 Tampa, Florida；波灣海域的軍事清雷、護航等行動由其統一指揮。
def.en: One of the US military's geographic combatant commands, responsible for the Middle East, Central Asia and parts of North Africa (including Iran, Iraq and the Gulf states); headquartered in Tampa, Florida. Military operations in the Gulf such as mine-clearing and escort missions fall under its command.

def.zh: 用於偵測、辨識、追蹤與擊落無人機的整套手段，通常分為偵測層（雷達、射頻、聲學、光電）與擊殺層（電子干擾、機砲、飛彈、雷射、攔截無人機）。其成本效益的關鍵指標是「每次接戰成本」，各技術之間可相差五個數量級以上。
def.en: The full stack of means for detecting, identifying, tracking and defeating drones, usually split into a detection layer (radar, RF, acoustic, electro-optical) and a defeat layer (jamming, guns, missiles, lasers, interceptor drones). Its key economic metric is cost per engagement, which varies by more than five orders of magnitude across technologies.

def.zh: 利用電磁頻譜進行攻擊、防護與支援的作戰領域，在反無人機脈絡中主要指干擾控制鏈路與欺騙衛星導航訊號。因不消耗彈藥，其每次接戰成本可低至美分等級，同時也是最便宜的廣域被動偵測手段；但對不發射無線電的目標（光纖導引或全自主機）同時失去攔截與偵測能力。
def.en: Military operations using the electromagnetic spectrum for attack, protection and support. In the counter-drone context it chiefly means jamming control links and spoofing satellite navigation. Because it expends no ordnance its cost per engagement can fall to cents, and it doubles as the cheapest wide-area passive sensor — but against targets that emit no radio (fiber-optic guided or fully autonomous) it loses both the intercept and the detection.

def.zh: 武器在飛行最後階段自行修正航向、鎖定並命中瞄準點的機制。在廉價無人機上，此功能由機上電腦與攝影機在最後數百公尺接管，因而同時免疫於電子干擾與無線電視距限制。這是現行各國法規（如 DoDD 3000.09）明文允許自主執行的功能，也因此成為自主武器管制定義上的主要爭議地帶。
def.en: The mechanism by which a weapon corrects its own course, locks on and hits an aim point during the final phase of flight. On cheap drones this is handled by an onboard computer and camera taking over for the last few hundred meters, which makes the weapon immune to both jamming and radio-horizon limits. It is a function that current national policies such as DoDD 3000.09 expressly permit to be autonomous, which is why it has become the principal contested zone in defining autonomous weapons.

def.zh: 飛行時放出一條輕量光纖線、以實體線路而非無線電傳輸控制訊號與影像的無人機。因完全不發射射頻訊號，對傳統干擾與衛星導航欺騙免疫，也難以被射頻偵測器發現；代價是受線軸長度限制、線體脆弱，且仍需一名操作員全程操控。
def.en: A drone that spools out a lightweight optical fiber in flight, carrying control signals and video over a physical line rather than radio. Because it emits no RF signature at all it is immune to conventional jamming and GNSS spoofing and largely invisible to RF detectors, at the cost of being limited by spool length, fragile in the line itself, and still requiring a human operator throughout.

def.zh: 提供定位與授時的衛星星系總稱，包含美國 GPS、中國 Beidou、俄羅斯 GLONASS 與歐盟 Galileo。因訊號抵達地面時極為微弱，容易被干擾或欺騙，這使得視覺里程計、慣性導航等非 GNSS 手段成為無人機在爭議電磁環境中的必要備援。
def.en: The collective term for satellite constellations providing positioning and timing, including the US GPS, China's BeiDou, Russia's GLONASS and the EU's Galileo. Because the signals are extremely weak by the time they reach the ground they are easily jammed or spoofed, which makes non-GNSS methods such as visual odometry and inertial guidance a necessary fallback for drones in contested electromagnetic environments.

def.zh: 把處理器、記憶體與電源管理整合在單一小型電路板上的運算模組，設計用於嵌入其他裝置。因為是為機器人、車載與零售等民用場景大量出貨的商用品項，價格低廉、全球流通，難以用針對尖端資料中心晶片的出口管制手段加以限制。
def.en: A compact compute board integrating processor, memory and power management, designed to be embedded inside another device. Because such modules ship in volume as commercial parts for robotics, automotive and retail applications, they are cheap and globally distributed, and are poorly addressed by export controls built around leading-edge datacenter silicon.

def.zh: 衡量 AI 推論晶片算力的單位，一 TOPS 等於每秒一兆次運算，通常標註所用數值精度（如 INT8）與是否採用稀疏化計算。此指標針對推論而非訓練，因此邊緣模組的 TOPS 數值與資料中心加速器的訓練算力不可直接比較。
def.en: A measure of AI inference throughput, where one TOPS equals one trillion operations per second, normally quoted with the numeric precision used (such as INT8) and whether sparsity is assumed. It measures inference rather than training, so an edge module's TOPS figure is not directly comparable with the training throughput of a datacenter accelerator.

terms.zh: Jetson Orin 邊緣運算模組

def.zh: Nvidia 面向邊緣 AI 推論的系統模組產品線，原為機器人與自主機具設計。其中 Jetson Orin NX 具 1,024 個 CUDA 核心與 32 個 Tensor 核心，稀疏 INT8 算力達 157 TOPS。烏克蘭軍事情報單位已多次在俄軍 Molniya 無人機、Shahed MS001 與 S-71M 巡弋飛彈殘骸中發現此類模組，用於機上目標辨識與終端導引。
def.en: Nvidia's product line of system-on-modules for edge AI inference, originally designed for robotics and autonomous machines. The Jetson Orin NX carries 1,024 CUDA cores and 32 Tensor cores, rated up to 157 sparse INT8 TOPS. Ukrainian military intelligence has repeatedly recovered modules from this family in Russian Molniya drones, Shahed MS001 airframes and S-71M cruise missiles, where they perform onboard target recognition and terminal guidance.

def.zh: 聯合國體系下由各國政府指派專家組成的談判前置機制。在自主武器議題上，CCW 架構下的 LAWS 政府專家小組自 2016 年運作至今，其三年授權將於 2026 年 11 月第七次審查會議屆滿，屆時各國須決定是進入正式談判、再延一次討論性授權，或讓進程失效。
def.en: A pre-negotiation mechanism under the UN system composed of experts nominated by member states. On autonomous weapons, the GGE on LAWS has operated under the CCW framework since 2016; its three-year mandate expires at the Seventh Review Conference in November 2026, when states must decide whether to open formal negotiations, roll over a discussion-only mandate, or let the process lapse.

def.zh: 規範武裝衝突行為的國際法體系，核心原則包括區分原則、比例原則與預防措施義務。在自主武器辯論中，主張不需新規則的國家（如俄羅斯）認為現行 IHL 已足以涵蓋高度自主系統，反對者則認為既有原則無法解決機器自行選定目標所帶來的可歸責性問題。
def.en: The body of international law governing conduct in armed conflict, resting on the principles of distinction, proportionality and precaution. In the autonomous weapons debate, states arguing that no new rules are needed — Russia foremost — hold that existing IHL already covers highly autonomous systems, while opponents argue those principles cannot resolve the accountability problem created when a machine selects its own target.

terms.zh: 美國國防部 3000.09 號指令
terms.expansion: Department of Defense Directive 3000.09, Autonomy in Weapon Systems

def.zh: 美國國防部關於武器系統自主性的政策指令，2012 年發布、2023 年 1 月更新。它將 LAWS 定義為「一經啟動即可在無人類操作者進一步介入下選定並接戰目標的武器系統」，但明文允許系統自主執行獲取、追蹤、辨識、目標提示、排序、開火時機與終端導引，條件是操作者保留對個別目標或特定目標群的選擇權。
def.en: The US Department of Defense policy directive on autonomy in weapon systems, issued in 2012 and updated in January 2023. It defines LAWS as a weapon system that, once activated, can select and engage targets without further intervention by a human operator, while expressly permitting autonomy for acquiring, tracking, identifying, cueing, prioritizing, timing of fire and terminal guidance, provided the operator retains control over the selection of individual targets and specific target groups.

terms.expansion: National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology

def.zh: 台灣國防科技研發的主要法人機構，負責飛彈、雷達、無人機與電子戰系統的自主研發與生產。審計部 2026 年度報告指出，其受空軍委託開發的反無人機系統落後 6 至 12 個月，且對光纖導引與 AI 導航無人機不具可行反制手段。
def.en: Taiwan's principal state-affiliated defense research and production body, responsible for indigenous development of missiles, radars, drones and electronic warfare systems. Taiwan's National Audit Office reported for fiscal 2026 that the counter-drone system NCSIST developed for the air force was six to twelve months behind schedule and had no viable countermeasure against fiber-optic guided or AI-navigated drones.

terms.zh: 未歸類威脅行為者（Cisco Talos命名編號）

def.zh: Cisco Talos用來標示「已觀察到一組具內部一致性的入侵活動，但尚未有足夠證據升級為正式命名威脅組織」的暫時性編號，性質與Mandiant的UNC編號相同；例如UAT-10147即為以此方式命名、其技術細節隨後續報告逐步補齊的中文語系財務動機駭客團伙。
def.en: A provisional designation Cisco Talos assigns to a cluster of intrusion activity that shows internal consistency but lacks sufficient evidence to be promoted to a formally named threat group — functionally identical to Mandiant's UNC designation. UAT-10147, the Chinese-speaking financially motivated group behind the SPECTRE backdoor, is one such case, with its tradecraft filled in report by report.

terms.zh: 自帶漏洞驅動程式攻擊

def.zh: 攻擊者刻意攜帶並載入一個合法簽章、但存在已知漏洞的第三方驅動程式，藉此取得作業系統核心層執行權限——因為驅動程式本身簽章合法，能繞過作業系統的驅動簽章驗證機制。取得核心層權限後，攻擊者可進一步從系統的通知鏈結中移除EDR的回呼函式，使其持續回報「正常運作」卻實際上偵測不到任何行為。
def.en: A technique in which an attacker deliberately loads a legitimately signed but known-vulnerable third-party driver to obtain kernel-level code execution — the driver's valid signature lets it slip past the operating system's driver-signing enforcement. With kernel access secured, the attacker can then strip an EDR product's callbacks out of the system's internal notification chain, leaving it reporting a healthy status while blind to all activity.

terms.zh: 天竺葵系列攻擊無人機

def.zh: 俄羅斯以伊朗Shahed-136為基礎、國產化量產的攻擊無人機系列。較新的Geran-3/4/5型加裝小型渦輪噴射引擎，時速可達約370公里、航程逾1,000公里，設計目的是以速度而非匿蹤或自主導引繞開防守方的攔截無人機，代價是單機成本顯著高於原本的螺旋槳動力型號。
def.en: Russia's domestically produced series of attack drones derived from Iran's Shahed-136. The newer Geran-3/4/5 variants add a small turbojet engine, reaching roughly 370 km/h with a range over 1,000 km — designed to defeat defender interceptor drones through raw speed rather than stealth or autonomous guidance, at the cost of a unit price well above the earlier propeller-driven versions.

def.zh: 以高功率微波脈衝燒毀或癱瘓目標電子元件的定向能武器。因每次發射的邊際成本極低且可同時涵蓋多個目標，被視為對抗無人機蜂群的關鍵手段之一；美方已展示其可擊落不受電子干擾影響的光纖導引 FPV 無人機。
def.en: A directed-energy weapon that burns out or disables a target's electronics with high-power microwave pulses. Because its marginal cost per shot is very low and a single pulse can cover multiple targets at once, it is regarded as a key answer to drone swarms; US forces have demonstrated it defeating fiber-optic guided FPV drones, which are immune to jamming.

terms.zh: 菸酒槍炮及爆裂物管理局
terms.expansion: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives

def.zh: 美國司法部轄下的聯邦執法機構，負責槍枝、爆裂物、酒類與菸草相關犯罪的調查與監管；2026年8月，其一台儲存調查目標資訊的獨立伺服器遭Qilin勒索軟體集團入侵。
def.en: A US Department of Justice law-enforcement agency responsible for firearms-, explosives-, alcohol-, and tobacco-related investigations and regulation; in August 2026, a standalone server holding information on its investigation targets was breached by the Qilin ransomware group.

def.zh: 中華人民共和國的武裝力量，法理上隸屬中國共產黨而非國家，下轄陸軍、海軍、空軍、火箭軍與軍事航天、網路空間等戰略支援部隊。在本站語境中，PLA 同時是台海態勢的主要行為者，也是網路與情報行動的委託方之一——DOJ 在 QTFY 案的法院文件中，即把解放軍與國家安全部並列為商用駭客平台的付費客戶。
def.en: The armed forces of the People's Republic of China, formally subordinate to the Chinese Communist Party rather than to the state, comprising ground, naval, air and rocket forces plus strategic support arms covering space and cyberspace. In this site's usage the PLA is both the principal actor shaping the Taiwan Strait picture and one of the commissioning parties behind cyber and intelligence operations — DOJ court filings in the QTFY case list the PLA alongside the Ministry of State Security as paying customers of a commercial hacking platform.

terms.zh: 中共中央統一戰線工作部
terms.expansion: United Front Work Department (of the CCP Central Committee)

def.zh: 中國共產黨中央委員會下轄的機構，負責對黨外人士、海外華人、宗教與少數民族團體及境外政治勢力進行影響與吸納工作。其操作特徵是透過形式上獨立的個人、社團與政黨管道達成北京想要的政治效果，因此外界即使觀察到結果，也往往難以取得可歸責於國家的直接證據——這正是本站所稱「中介化」手法的政治版本。
def.en: A department of the CCP Central Committee responsible for influencing and co-opting non-party figures, overseas Chinese communities, religious and ethnic organisations, and political forces abroad. Its defining feature is achieving Beijing's desired political effect through nominally independent individuals, associations and party channels, so observers may see the outcome and still lack evidence attributable to the state — the political counterpart of what this site calls intermediation.

terms.zh: 乙支自由之盾聯合軍演

def.zh: 美國與南韓每年夏季舉行的大規模聯合軍事演習，以指揮所推演與電腦模擬為主體，結合部分實兵科目，是美韓同盟年度訓練週期中最主要的一場。演習規模與是否照常舉行長期被雙方與北韓同時當成政治訊號來讀，因此其縮減或延期往往傳達的是外交姿態而非軍事評估。
def.en: The large annual summer exercise between the United States and South Korea, built around command-post drills and computer simulation with some field training attached, and the centrepiece of the alliance's yearly training cycle. Its scale, and whether it proceeds as planned, are read as political signals by Washington, Seoul and Pyongyang alike — so a reduction or postponement usually communicates a diplomatic posture rather than a military assessment.

def.zh: 俄軍使用的廉價攻擊無人機，機身以膠合板與泡棉製作，單價約 300 至 1,600 美元，每月發射數以千計。部分機型搭載機上運算模組執行終端自主導引，且不裝設對外通訊天線、全程不發射無線電訊號，使依賴電子戰偵測與干擾的防空手段同時失去偵測與攔截能力。2026 年 7 月 Zaporizhzhia 造成 3 名平民死亡的攻擊，即由這型無人機的機上模組自行選定瞄準點。
def.en: A low-cost Russian strike drone with a plywood-and-foam airframe, costing roughly $300–1,600 per unit and launched in the thousands each month. Some variants carry an onboard compute module for autonomous terminal guidance and fly with no communications antenna and no radio emission at all, denying electronic-warfare-based air defences both detection and interception. The July 2026 attack that killed three civilians in Zaporizhzhia had its aimpoint selected by such a drone's onboard module.

terms.expansion: The Fourth Law TFL-1 terminal guidance module

def.zh: 烏克蘭自主技術公司 The Fourth Law 開發的機上終端導引模組，在攻擊的最後約 500 公尺把控制權從人類操作者移交給機上電腦。公開資料指其讓單機成本上升約一成、打擊效果提高 2 至 4 倍，並同時克服電子戰干擾與無線電視距限制——這組成本效益比正是終端自主在戰場上迅速擴散的直接原因，也讓操作員人數不再是無人機打擊量的天花板。
def.en: An onboard terminal-guidance module developed by Ukrainian firm The Fourth Law that hands control from the human operator to the aircraft's own computer for roughly the final 500 metres of an attack. Public figures put the cost increase at about ten percent per airframe for a two- to fourfold gain in strike effect, while defeating both jamming and radio line-of-sight limits. That cost-benefit ratio is the direct cause of terminal autonomy's rapid spread, and it removes operator headcount as the ceiling on strike volume.

def.zh: Google Threat Intelligence Group 與 Mandiant 自 2025 年起追蹤的後門程式，歸因於中國關聯集群 UNC5221，平均在受害網路內停留 393 天。其載體選擇是刻意的：部署在網路邊界設備與 VMware vCenter／ESXi 這類不支援傳統 EDR 代理程式的資產上，而這些設備通常不在受害組織的監控範圍內、甚至根本沒有被列進資產清冊——長停留時間的主因是能見度缺口，不是隱匿技術本身。
def.en: A backdoor tracked by Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant since 2025 and attributed to the China-linked cluster UNC5221, averaging 393 days of dwell time inside victim networks. Its carrier choice is deliberate: it is deployed on network edge appliances and on VMware vCenter and ESXi hosts, assets that cannot run a conventional EDR agent and that frequently sit outside the victim's monitoring scope or absent from the asset inventory altogether. The long dwell is a visibility gap rather than a triumph of stealth.

def.zh: 泛指無線電頻段的電磁訊號。在反無人機語境中，「RF 偵測」是指靠接收目標與操作者之間的無線電鏈路來發現來襲目標，成本極低且可覆蓋廣域，長期是防守方最便宜的偵測層；但面對光纖導引或機上自主導引、全程不發射訊號的目標，這一層同時失去偵測與干擾能力，防守方被迫退回聲學、光學與雷達等成本隨防守面積成長的手段。
def.en: Electromagnetic signals in the radio bands. In counter-drone usage, RF detection means finding an incoming target by picking up the radio link between it and its operator — very cheap and able to cover wide areas, which long made it the defender's least expensive sensing layer. Against fibre-optic guided or onboard-autonomous drones that emit nothing at all, that layer loses both detection and jamming at once, forcing defenders back onto acoustic, optical and radar methods whose cost scales with the area defended rather than the number of threats.

def.zh: 情報、監視與偵察三項功能的合稱，泛指以各類感測平台蒐集目標資訊並轉化為可用情報的整套活動與裝備。在現代戰場上，ISR 與打擊手段結合成「偵察-打擊複合體」，其節點（無人機、預警機、資料鏈與指管系統）本身即成為高價值攻擊目標——先癱瘓對方的 ISR 再行滲透，已被烏克蘭戰場多次驗證為有效手法。
def.en: The combined functions of intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance: the platforms, sensors and processes that collect information on targets and turn it into usable intelligence. On the modern battlefield ISR fuses with strike assets into a reconnaissance-strike complex whose nodes — drones, airborne early warning aircraft, data links and command systems — become high-value targets in their own right. Blinding an opponent's ISR before infiltrating has been demonstrated repeatedly in Ukraine.

terms.expansion: Sluzhba Bezpeky Ukrainy (Security Service of Ukraine)

def.zh: 烏克蘭主要的國內情報與反情報機構，負責反恐、反間諜與國家安全相關刑事偵辦；其職權與負責對外軍事情報的 HUR 之間存在管轄重疊，尤其在處理非正規武裝或外籍志願單位時容易產生機構摩擦。
def.en: Ukraine's principal domestic intelligence and counterintelligence agency, responsible for counterterrorism, counterespionage and national-security criminal investigations. Its jurisdiction overlaps with HUR's foreign military-intelligence remit, particularly over irregular or foreign volunteer units, which can produce inter-agency friction.

def.zh: 俄羅斯主要的國內情報與反情報機構，前身為蘇聯 KGB 的國內職能部門，負責反情報、反恐與部分對外行動，是烏克蘭官方最常點名的滲透與暗殺行動歸責對象。
def.en: Russia's principal domestic intelligence and counterintelligence agency, successor to the KGB's internal functions, responsible for counterintelligence, counterterrorism and some external operations. It is the agency Ukrainian officials most often name in attributing infiltration and assassination plots.

def.zh: 一支由反 Putin 俄羅斯民族主義者組成、替烏克蘭作戰的外籍武裝單位，曾多次跨境突襲俄羅斯本土的 Belgorod 等地區；因成員身分特殊（俄羅斯公民為烏克蘭作戰），其指揮歸屬與情報監管長期處於 HUR 與 SBU 管轄的灰色地帶。
def.en: A paramilitary unit of anti-Putin Russian nationalists fighting on Ukraine's side, known for cross-border raids into Russian territory such as Belgorod. Because its members are Russian citizens fighting for Ukraine, its chain of command and intelligence oversight has long sat in a jurisdictional gray zone between HUR and the SBU.

def.zh: 軟體開發中用於自動化建置、測試與部署程式碼的流程與工具鏈；由於 CI/CD 系統通常持有雲端環境的高權限存取金鑰，一旦遭劫持就能被攻擊者用來大規模竊取憑證或部署惡意程式，是近期供應鏈與雲端入侵事件中反覆出現的樞紐環節。
def.en: The automated pipeline and toolchain used in software development to build, test and deploy code. Because CI/CD systems typically hold high-privilege access keys into cloud environments, hijacking one lets an attacker harvest credentials or deploy malicious code at scale — a recurring pivot point in recent supply-chain and cloud-intrusion incidents.

def.zh: 衛星導航系統實際提供的三項服務的合稱。三者常被混為一談，但脆弱性完全不同：定位有慣性導航、地面導航台等替代品；授時（Timing）在民用基礎設施中幾乎沒有替代品，卻被電信同步、電網相量量測與金融時戳合規標準深度依賴。討論 GNSS 韌性時，先問對方指的是 P、N 還是 T，答案往往決定整個結論。
def.en: The three services a satellite navigation system actually delivers. They are routinely conflated but fail very differently: positioning has substitutes (inertial navigation, ground aids), while timing has almost none in civil infrastructure yet is depended on by telecom sync, grid phasor measurement and financial timestamping compliance. When someone says 'GNSS resilience', ask which of the three they mean — the answer usually decides the conclusion.

def.zh: 以地面高功率長波發射台提供定位與授時的陸基系統，是二戰時期 Loran-C 的現代化版本。訊號功率遠高於衛星訊號、頻率極低，因此難以被干擾或偽冒，被視為 GNSS 的主要陸基備援。中國已建成全國網並延伸至海岸外約 1,600 公里；英國訂於 2028 年初達初始作戰能力、2030 年完全作戰能力；美國至今僅停留在示範合約階段。
def.en: A terrestrial system delivering position and time from high-power long-wave ground transmitters, the modernised descendant of WWII-era Loran-C. Its signals are vastly stronger and far lower in frequency than satellite signals, making them hard to jam or spoof — hence its status as the primary terrestrial backup to GNSS. China has completed a national network reaching roughly 1,600 km offshore; the UK targets initial operating capability in early 2028 and full capability in 2030; the US remains at the demonstration-contract stage.

def.zh: 中國自主建設的全球衛星導航系統，與 GPS、Galileo、GLONASS 並列四大 GNSS。其民用訊號頻段與 GPS 重疊，中國技術社群公開將此描述為一種戰略嚇阻——針對北斗民用訊號的干擾必然同時打到 GPS。
def.en: China's indigenous global navigation satellite system, one of the four GNSS alongside GPS, Galileo and GLONASS. Its civil signal bands overlap with GPS, which Chinese technical commentary openly frames as strategic deterrence: interference aimed at BeiDou civil signals necessarily hits GPS as well.

terms.zh: 中國科學院國家授時中心
terms.expansion: National Time Service Center (Chinese Academy of Sciences)

def.zh: 中國的國家授時機構，維持中國標準時間 UTC(NTSC)，並主導高精度地基授時系統的建設。UTC(NTSC) 是中國境內所有授時服務的最終回溯基準，地位相當於美國的 UTC(NIST)／UTC(USNO)。
def.en: China's national timing authority, which maintains China Standard Time UTC(NTSC) and leads construction of the High-precision Ground-based Timing System. UTC(NTSC) is the ultimate traceability reference for all timing services inside China, occupying the role UTC(NIST)/UTC(USNO) play in the US.

def.zh: 國際標準時間基準，由各國時頻實驗室的原子鐘加權合成。金融、電信與電網的合規要求通常不是「準確」，而是「可追溯至 UTC」——必須能證明本地時鐘與 UTC 的關係。實務上這條追溯鏈多半經由 GNSS 建立，因此 UTC 可追溯性在技術上往往等同於 GNSS 依賴。
def.en: The international time standard, formed by weighting atomic clocks across national time laboratories. Compliance requirements in finance, telecom and power are usually not for accuracy as such but for traceability to UTC — you must be able to demonstrate your local clock's relationship to it. In practice that chain is normally established via GNSS, so UTC traceability is often technically identical to a GNSS dependency.

def.zh: 在區域網路內分送高精度時間的協定，精度可達次微秒至奈秒級，遠優於 NTP。資料中心與交易機房通常以一台「母鐘」（grandmaster）接收 GNSS 時間，再用 PTP 分送給各伺服器；這個架構意味著整個機房的時間正確性收斂到母鐘那一個 GNSS 接收點上。
def.en: A protocol for distributing high-precision time inside a local network, reaching sub-microsecond to nanosecond accuracy, far tighter than NTP. Data centres and trading floors typically have one grandmaster clock take time from GNSS and distribute it by PTP to servers — an architecture that funnels the entire facility's time correctness through that single GNSS reception point.

def.zh: 以 GPS 訊號持續校正本地振盪器的授時設備，是絕大多數民用基礎設施取得精確時間的實體裝置。其關鍵規格不是鎖定時的精度（都很好），而是失去 GPS 後的 holdover 漂移率——那才決定它能在干擾下撐多久。
def.en: A timing device that continuously corrects a local oscillator against GPS signals; it is the physical box through which most civil infrastructure obtains precise time. Its critical specification is not locked accuracy (which is uniformly good) but holdover drift after GPS is lost — that is what determines how long it survives jamming.

def.zh: 授時設備在失去 GNSS 參考後，僅靠本地振盪器維持時間的運作狀態。漂移率取決於振盪器等級：銣原子鐘 24 小時約漂移 100 至 500 奈秒，一般 OCXO 約 1 至 10 微秒。把合規門檻除以漂移率，就得到一個機房能承受多少小時 GNSS 中斷的具體數字——這是目前極少被稽核的韌性指標。
def.en: The state in which a timing device maintains time on its local oscillator alone after losing its GNSS reference. Drift depends on oscillator grade: a rubidium clock drifts roughly 100–500 nanoseconds over 24 hours, a typical OCXO 1–10 microseconds. Dividing a compliance threshold by the drift rate yields a concrete number of hours of GNSS outage a facility can absorb — a resilience metric almost nobody currently audits.

terms.zh: 開放服務導航訊息認證

def.zh: 歐盟 Galileo 提供的導航訊息認證服務，2025 年 7 月 24 日宣告正式運作，讓接收機能驗證導航資料確實來自 Galileo 且未遭竄改。關鍵限制：它針對的是偽冒（spoofing），對干擾（jamming）完全無效——訊號被壓到雜訊底下時沒有東西可驗證；且必須在接收機端實作才生效。
def.en: Galileo's navigation message authentication service, declared operational on 24 July 2025, letting receivers verify that navigation data genuinely comes from Galileo and is untampered. The critical limit: it addresses spoofing, not jamming — once the signal is buried under the noise floor there is nothing left to authenticate — and it only takes effect once implemented at receiver level.

terms.expansion: Low Earth Orbit Positioning, Navigation and Timing

def.zh: 以低地球軌道衛星（而非 GPS 所在的 20,200 公里中軌）提供 PNT 服務的架構。因為距離近，訊號到達地面的強度可高出既有 GNSS 約 1,000 倍，抗干擾門檻因此大幅提高。代表案例為 Xona Space Systems 的 Pulsar（規劃最多 258 顆，沿用既有 L 頻段硬體）。
def.en: An architecture delivering PNT from low Earth orbit rather than the 20,200 km medium orbit GPS occupies. The shorter range means signals arrive up to a thousand times stronger than legacy GNSS, sharply raising the anti-jam threshold. The reference case is Xona Space Systems' Pulsar (up to 258 satellites planned, reusing existing L-band hardware).

def.zh: 以同一訊號抵達多個已知位置接收站的時間差反推發射源座標的定位技術。用於干擾源與偽冒源的地理定位——Gdynia 海事大學與德國宇航中心即以此把波羅的海 GNSS 干擾源指向加里寧格勒的 Okunevo 天線陣。這是干擾行為在技術上仍可被歸因的主要原因。
def.en: A geolocation technique that infers an emitter's coordinates from the differing arrival times of one signal at multiple receivers of known position. It is how jammers and spoofers get located — Gdynia Maritime University and Germany's DLR used it to point Baltic GNSS interference at the Okunevo antenna complex in Kaliningrad. It is the main reason interference remains technically attributable at all.

def.zh: 聯合國轄下負責國際民航規則的專門機構，其法律基礎是 1944 年芝加哥公約。2025 年 10 月大會依六個歐洲成員國提交的證據，認定源自俄羅斯與北韓的重複性 GNSS 射頻干擾違反該公約——這是史上首次的正式歸屬，但該組織不具強制執行力。
def.en: The UN specialised agency governing international civil aviation, grounded in the 1944 Chicago Convention. In October 2025 its Assembly, on evidence from six European member states, found that recurring GNSS radio-frequency interference originating from Russia and the DPRK breaches the Convention — the first formal attribution of its kind, from a body with no enforcement power.

def.zh: 歐盟的航空安全主管機關。針對 GNSS 干擾持續發布安全資訊通報（SIB），並與 IATA 建立聯合行動計畫。其通報是目前追蹤歐洲與周邊空域干擾熱區（波羅的海、黑海、東地中海、中東）最權威的公開來源之一。
def.en: The EU's aviation safety regulator. It issues Safety Information Bulletins on GNSS interference and runs a joint action plan with IATA. Its bulletins are among the most authoritative open sources for tracking interference hotspots in and around European airspace — the Baltic, Black Sea, eastern Mediterranean and Middle East.

terms.zh: 歐盟時鐘同步技術標準

def.zh: MiFID II 下規範交易場所與投資公司業務時鐘同步的技術標準。要求時間基準為 UTC，最大偏離按閘道對閘道延遲分級：延遲大於 1 毫秒者為 1 毫秒，小於等於 1 毫秒者為 100 微秒（即高頻交易那一格）。它要求對 UTC 的可追溯性與文件化，但未規定備援來源——因此一個完全合規的交易場所可以是單一 GNSS 依賴。
def.en: The technical standard under MiFID II governing business clock synchronisation for trading venues and investment firms. It mandates UTC as the time reference, with maximum divergence tiered by gateway-to-gateway latency: 1 millisecond above 1 ms latency, 100 microseconds at or below (the high-frequency trading tier). It requires traceability to UTC and documentation but does not mandate a backup source — so a fully compliant venue can be a single-source GNSS dependency.

def.zh: 雲端服務模式的一種，業者提供應用程式部署所需的執行環境、資料庫與基礎設施管理，開發者只需上傳程式碼即可運行，不必自行維運底層伺服器。因為平台代管大量客戶的環境變數與憑證，一旦平台本身的內部管理憑證外洩，等於同時暴露所有客戶儲存在該平台上的第三方服務金鑰。
def.en: A cloud service model in which the provider manages the runtime environment, database and underlying infrastructure needed to run an application, so developers deploy code without operating servers themselves. Because the platform holds large numbers of customers' environment variables and credentials in one place, a leak of the platform's own internal administrative credential can expose every customer's third-party service keys stored on it at once.

def.zh: Amazon旗下的雲端運算平台，提供運算、儲存、資料庫等基礎設施服務，是全球市佔率最高的公有雲供應商之一，許多PaaS與SaaS業者本身即建立在其基礎設施之上。
def.en: Amazon's cloud computing platform, offering compute, storage and database infrastructure services. It is one of the largest public-cloud providers globally, and many PaaS and SaaS businesses are themselves built on top of its infrastructure.
